items.title: Controlled self-healing Amazon EKS Clusters with AWS DevOps Agent and A2A remote agents
items.summary: 1. Introduction A pod on your Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster is restarting on a memory limit. An automated agent spots it, doubles the memory, and syncs the application. On a quiet afternoon that is a tidy self healing story.
